presets.notYou: If this was not you, secure your account now.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your e-mail address
verifyEmail.preheader: One click to confirm your address.
verifyEmail.title: Confirm your e-mail address
verifyEmail.body: Confirm that this address is yours to finish setting up your {brand} account.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.preheader: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your {brand} account. Choose a new one with the button below.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.preheader: The password of your account was just changed.
passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your {brand} account was just changed.

emailChanged.subject: Your e-mail address was changed
emailChanged.preheader: Your account now signs in with a new address.
emailChanged.title: Your e-mail address was changed
emailChanged.body: Your {brand} account now uses {newEmail}. We send this notice to your former address.

signInCode.subject: Your sign-in code: {code}
signInCode.preheader: Enter this code to sign in.
signInCode.title: Your sign-in code
signInCode.body: Enter this code to sign in to {brand}. It works once.
signInCode.ignore: If you did not try to sign in, you can ignore this e-mail: no one can sign in without the code.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.title: Sign in to {brand}
magicLink.body: Click the button below to sign in. The link works once.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.preheader: Your account was signed in from a new device.
newSignIn.title: New sign-in to your account
newSignIn.banner: Your account was signed in from a device we had not seen.
newSignIn.body: If this was you, there is nothing to do.

welcome.subject: Welcome, {name}
welcome.title: Welcome to {brand}
welcome.body: Your account is ready. Everything you need is one click away.
